## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at Parc Zoologique de Paris, Av. Daumesnil, 75012 Paris, France. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entry tickets to Parc Zoologique de Paris.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Look out for the Big Rock, a 65m artificial mini-mountain and the hallmark of the Parc Zoologique de Paris!
>
> As it comes into view, anticipate an encounter with diverse wildlife like giraffes, rhinos, lemurs, seals, and young lions. Don't leave your camera behind for this animal-filled adventure.
>
> Previously known as Bois de Vincennes Zoological Park, the park underwent a 27-month refurbishment and reopened in 2014. It now features five biozones, allowing you to journey from Europe to Madagascar, Africa to Patagonia, and even the Amazon.
>
> In Africa, spot lions, giraffes, and zebras, while Europe houses wolves, lynxes, and otters. The Amazon zone is a haven for jaguars, monkeys, and macaws, while Patagonia hosts penguins, pumas, and pudus.
>
> But that's not all! The park is also home to a plethora of birds, lizards, snakes, tarantulas, frogs, fish, and mammals. If you're an animal enthusiast, you're in for an unforgettable treat that will leave a lasting smile on your face. The Parc Zoologique de Paris is more than a zoo — it's a worldwide wildlife expedition in the heart of Paris.
